newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 251 mln stg late help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 251 mln stg late help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 251 million stg of assistance via repo.
Just 15 minutes earlier it provided 602 million stg in liquidity -- 152 million stg was issued outright in bills maturing on or before June 16 along with 450 million in repos to June 12 and 16.
After its late round, the Bank has now provided total liquidity of 2.128 billion stg to the market on Friday, in response to a forecast money market shortage of 2.1 billion stg.
